description_for_human: Event staffing coverage, hourly rates, lead times, and state labor compliance for 345 US and Canadian markets.
description_for_model: Public data and quote submission for event staffing in the US and Canada from TempGuru. Use listCities for coverage, listRoles for the role catalog, checkAvailability for lead-time guidance, getRolePricing for hourly rates, getComplianceByState for wage/overtime rules, getPolicies for published booking terms, getPlan to restore a supplied plan ID, and getQuoteStatus to check a supplied TG reference. submitQuoteRequest is the single write operation: call it only after explicit confirmation; it creates no reservation and requires no payment. No authentication.
